name: FindBar
description:
A find control for logs, tables and long documents. It holds no search logic: the host
owns matching and tells the bar how many matches there are, which one is current and
whether the count is still climbing. Options come through the `toggles` slot.

Stability  the count's width is reserved, so a climbing count moves nothing (R9.1). Past
           9,999 it abbreviates to stay inside that width.
Announce   the outcome goes to a polite region that stays mounted, once it settles; the
           ticking count never does (R20.9).
Keys       Enter next · Shift+Enter previous · Esc closes and returns focus (R20.3).
           In the replace field Enter replaces the current match.
Width      below 28rem the options and count take a second row.
signature: ({ value: valueProp, defaultValue, onValueChange, open: openProp, defaultOpen, onOpenChange, replaceValue: replaceValueProp, defaultReplaceValue, onReplaceValueChange, replaceOpen: replaceOpenProp, defaultReplaceOpen, onReplaceOpenChange, ...rest }: FindBarProps): import("react").JSX.Element | null

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the search landmark. Default "Find".

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus the term and select it on mount. It is always focused when `open` turns true. Default false.

props.name: className
props.description: Layout classes.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The initial state when uncontrolled. Default true.

props.name: defaultReplaceOpen
props.description: The initial state when uncontrolled. Default false.

props.name: defaultReplaceValue
props.description: The initial replacement when uncontrolled. Default empty.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial term when uncontrolled. Default empty.

props.name: floating
props.description:
Float at the top end of the nearest positioned ancestor, on overlay glass. Put that
ancestor around the scroller, not inside it: the bar stays clear of the scroll edge and
the scrollbar, and the scroller needs `scroll-padding-block-start` so a revealed match
is not left under it. Default false, for a bar in the page flow.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: Receives the term's input.

props.name: matchCount
props.description: Matches found so far. Leave undefined until there is something to count.

props.name: matchIndex
props.description: The current match, counted from 0. Leave undefined when none is current.

props.name: onNext
props.description: Move to the next match: the button, or Enter in the term.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when Escape or the close button asks to close.

props.name: onPrevious
props.description: Move to the previous match: the button, or Shift+Enter in the term.

props.name: onReplace
props.description: Replace the current match. Supplying it, or `onReplaceAll`, offers the replace row.

props.name: onReplaceAll
props.description: Replace every match.

props.name: onReplaceOpenChange
props.description: Called when the disclosure button is pressed.

props.name: onReplaceValueChange
props.description: Called with the replacement on every edit.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the term on every edit. The host runs the search.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the bar is showing, controlled.

props.name: replaceOpen
props.description: Whether the replace row is showing, controlled.

props.name: replaceValue
props.description: The replacement text, controlled.

props.name: returnFocusRef
props.description: Where focus goes on closing. Default: the element that had focus before the bar did.

props.name: searching
props.description: The search is still running, so `matchCount` may climb. The count shows "128+" and is announced only once it settles.

props.name: toggles
props.description: Search options, usually pressed icon buttons for case, whole word and pattern. The host owns their state and their meaning.

props.name: value
props.description: The search term, controlled.
